method: One-time AI-assisted multi-city search: directly checked public organizer website, public local news, and Sina's robots-allowed mirror of posts attributed to verified organizer accounts; original Weibo pages were not fetched. No private platform endpoint, ticket database, article prose, images, or ticket prices imported.
